0.0: Hey there. You're looking pretty tough lately. Maybe you'd like to get stronger?

no.0: Ah, I knew you were a slacker the moment I saw you.

0.1: Ever heard of Ossyria? I think a little trip there would really toughen you up.
0.2: If you can make it to the Six Path Crossway, you can get to Ossyria. You could also get to Orbis from an airship here on Victoria Island. Just do me a favor and pass something along to #b#p2012011##k when you get there. These are the #b#t4031197##k, but you don't need to know anything about them.
0.3: Kriel makes a variety of magical tools and reagents in Orbis. If you see her, give her the stuff and tell her I said hello.\r\n#b(You will automatically travel to Orbis if you accept.)

1.0: Did Manji send you with the Tears of Kelvelos?

yes.0: It's about time! I've been waiting for that smirking buffoon to bring me a #b#t4031197##k for... Ahem. I'm sorry, I meant to say, thank you.

npc.0: What are you waiting for? Afraid of faeries? Go see #bKriel#k in Orbis.

lost.0: Don't you dare lose those. Give them to Kriel in Orbis.

QuestInfo.name: A World Apart
QuestInfo.1: Manji asked if you wanted to become more powerful, but he had an ulterior motive. He wanted you to give something to #bKriel the Fairy#k in Orbis.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the Tears of Kelvelos to Kriel.
